name: References Secret
description: An ECS task definition revision names a Secrets Manager secret for one of its containers (revision -> secret): containerDefinitions[].secrets[].valueFrom, mapped back to the secret's own ARN by dropping any :json-key:version-stage:version-id suffix. A name in a document, not a read: the ECS agent fetches the value under the execution role when a container starts, and that runtime flow is not this edge. One edge per revision and secret, whichever containers and variables name it; which do is in the revision's configuration.
